description: Behaviour analysis for the seeds1-5 ablation checkpoints: fill the ten missing reset-excluded test-accuracy collects (mamba_nowrap, s5_nowrap) and run the target-switch recovery inference for every finished unit.

notes: Launched by experiments/clutter/amarel/submit_clutter_ablation_behavior.sh (compute-node launcher experiments/clutter/amarel/run_clutter_ablation_behavior.sh); the launcher runs the recovery inference for every unit whose final checkpoint exists, and fills the reset-excluded test-accuracy collect only when its JSON is missing.
